design_note: Thirty all-atom C44H90 chains, three independent seeds and 10 ns production per replica are project choices, not a reproduction of the published united-atom system. A completed run is accepted only after density stationarity, chain decorrelation and reference-comparison checks.

reference.citation: Lee, Frank and Yoon, Polymers 12 (2020), 1059, Table 2
reference.tolerance_basis: Project comparison tolerance across different force fields; not a published uncertainty.
reference.pressure_note: This benchmark uses 1 atm. The cited table does not specify the bulk NPT pressure.
